default_amm.description:
Default value of the AMM (auto margin management) flag on the
 platform.

user_can_change_amm.description:
Flag indicating whether the user is allowed to change the AMM (auto
 margin management) flag.

user_can_change_amr_isolated.description:
Flag indicating whether the user is allowed to change the AMR (auto
 margin replenishment) flag of isolated margin accounts.

user_can_change_amr_cross.description:
Flag indicating whether the user is allowed to change the AMR (auto
 margin replenishment) flag of cross-margin accounts.

current_amm.description:
Effective value of the AMM (auto margin management) flag of the user:
 either the value set by the user or the default one.

ℹ️ This is the value the exchange web interface puts into
 `margin_auto` of every new order.

amm_override_set.description:
Flag indicating whether the user has set an own value of the AMM
 (auto margin management) flag instead of the default one.
